description: Selected active meters report zero/stale readings because simulated field communication failed.
recommended_next_step: Check upstream polling platform, device status, and whether corrected measurement values were posted.

description: A retry creates duplicate meter/timestamp records with different raw_reading_id values.
recommended_next_step: Group by meter_id and reading_timestamp; inspect batch retry history.

description: Source feed contains meter IDs missing from meter_master.
recommended_next_step: Validate source meter IDs against meter_master and update mapping or reject feed.

description: Valid readings arrive after the normal reporting refresh window.
recommended_next_step: Compare event, poll, load, and report refresh timestamps.

description: Meters repeat stale values and quality codes for several hours.
recommended_next_step: Check tag freshness, polling logs, and communication status.

description: A small source batch is dated in the future.
recommended_next_step: Reject future-dated records and review source date mapping.

description: Measurement records are extracted before approval/close.
recommended_next_step: Filter reporting to approved/closed records and check close workflow.

description: Corrected measurement volume materially differs from raw aggregate.
recommended_next_step: Compare raw aggregate to measured and corrected volume by meter/date.

description: Publisher step has rejected records and partial success status.
expected_root_cause: Target load rejected a subset of records
recommended_next_step: Review publisher error rows, rejected count, and target acceptance rules.

description: Source facility assignment conflicts with meter_master.
recommended_next_step: Validate meter-to-facility mapping and effective dates.

description: Source feed contains quality codes outside accepted values.
recommended_next_step: Review accepted values and source code translation table.

description: Inactive meters continue to produce readings.
recommended_next_step: Confirm meter status and effective dates before including in reports.

description: A small set of active meters sends null volumes.
recommended_next_step: Check source payload and apply null-volume exception handling.

description: A small number of impossible negative values appear in raw readings.
recommended_next_step: Reject negative values and review source calculation.

description: Actual measured volume materially differs from nominated volume.
recommended_next_step: Compare actual vs nominated by facility/date/product and review exception impact.
